name: ARN Smart URL Manager
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart URL Manager is a free WordPress plugin that keeps all your links in one place: 301 and 302 redirects, short links on your own domain, 512 px PNG QR codes, a link-in-bio page and local click tracking – managed from one dashboard, with no external link service, no account and no license key.

Instead of scattering links across plugins, outside shortening services, QR generators and bio platforms, URL Manager keeps them on your own site: redirects and short links in a few fields, a QR code for every short link that keeps working when its destination changes, and click counts for each link. The URL Health scan checks your post and page URLs in the background for routing conflicts and duplicate risks.

✨ Why URL Manager?

  • One plugin for your links – redirects, short links, QR codes, a bio page, URL Health and analytics in one menu and one settings screen.
  • Your own domain – short links like example.com/s/abc12/ and the bio page at example.com/bio/your-name/.
  • Turn on only what you use – any of the six modules can be switched off under Settings.
  • Your data stays on your site – links, QR files and click data stay in your WordPress database and uploads folder; no ARN server is contacted.
  • Privacy-minded tracking – no cookies, no stored IP addresses or full user agents; you choose what is collected and for how long.
  • Ready for Pro, never forced – ARN Smart Linkix Pro uses the same data; Free keeps working on its own.

🔁 301 and 302 redirects

Send old, moved or deleted addresses to the right place under ARN Smart Linkix → Redirects.

  • Simple rules: a source path, a target URL on your site or another website, and 301 Permanent or 302 Temporary; edit or delete rules at any time.
  • Pages that no longer exist: a rule works even when WordPress has no page at the source path, such as a deleted page’s old address.
  • Subdirectory and non-Latin paths: on a subdirectory site (example.com/blog) source paths can be relative to the site; accented and non-Latin paths are stored percent-encoded, so “café” and “cafe” stay separate rules.
  • Overview and search: redirect and hit totals, a hit counter per rule and search across source paths and targets.

🔗 Short links on your own domain

Create clean, trackable short URLs under ARN Smart Linkix → Short Links.

  • Custom or random slugs: your own slug or a random 5-character one; set any short link Active or Disabled.
  • Editable destinations: change the target URL at any time – the short link and its QR code stay the same.
  • Posts and pages: use the Create Short Link action in the Posts, Pages and other content lists, or the Linkix URL Panel in the editor with Copy, Open and Regenerate buttons and a QR preview. A post’s short link follows the post’s current address while it is published.
  • Your own prefix: /s/<slug>/ by default, changeable under Settings; with “Plain” permalinks, short links use query addresses (see FAQ).
  • Safe routing: a real page under the prefix (a child page of a page named “s”) still opens, and a short link pointing to its own address answers 404 instead of looping.
  • Workspace: totals for links, active and disabled links, hits, QR codes and missing QR codes; search by slug, target or content type and filter by status.

📱 QR codes and QR Studio

Print-ready QR codes for short links and anything else.

  • QR for every short link: a 512 px PNG with the standard four-module quiet zone, on the short link card and in the editor panel, with a PNG download. It encodes the short link, so it survives destination changes.
  • QR colors: foreground and background under Settings → QR & branding.
  • Automatic or on demand: with “Generate QR output automatically when a shortlink exists” on, the QR is drawn right away; otherwise only downloads, bulk actions and maintenance tools draw it. Visitor requests never draw QR images.
  • Bulk actions: generate, regenerate or export the selected QR codes as PNG files in one ZIP archive.
  • QR maintenance tools: Missing QR scan, Regenerate missing QR, Cleanup orphan QR files and Rebuild all QR run in short background steps with progress.
  • QR Studio: standalone QR codes for a URL or plain text with a label and scan text, in a saved library to copy, download or delete – no short link needed.
  • Local QR engine: a bundled pure PHP engine draws QR codes on your server (PHP GD extension required) and stores them in your uploads folder.

📊 Click tracking and analytics

Local click statistics under ARN Smart Linkix → Analytics, without an outside analytics service.

  • Clicks and unique clicks: total events, clicks and unique clicks (a visitor’s first visit to the same link within 24 hours) for short links and redirects.
  • Top links: the most used short links and redirects with hits, unique hits, last hit, source and device.
  • Breakdowns and trend: recent activity, source and device breakdowns and the last 14 days.
  • Unresolved requests: 404 visitor requests are counted, without crawlers and at most 30 entries per visitor every 10 minutes, so random addresses cannot fill the tables.
  • You decide what is collected: switches for short link hits, redirect hits, unresolved requests, referrer classification, device classification and raw event logs, plus raw log retention (90 days by default, at least 7). Per-link click totals survive log cleanup.

🌐 Link-in-bio page

Build one public link-in-bio page for your social profiles under ARN Smart Linkix → Bio Pages.

  • Identity: title, slug, description, intro text and an image or logo from the Media Library; the page opens at /bio/<slug>/.
  • Buttons and social links: one per line (Label | URL, Platform | URL); a click goes only to a link saved on that page.
  • Visual settings: primary, button and text colors, a solid, gradient or custom CSS background, title, description and intro font sizes, logo width and an effect (Fade, Side fade, Up fade, Glow or Heart).
  • Local fonts: System, Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato or Poppins, bundled with the plugin; no request goes to a font service.
  • Preview, QR and counters: a live phone-style preview, a QR code of the page address with a PNG download, and view and click counters. Right-to-left sites draw the page right to left.

🛡️ URL Health and Smart URL Advisor

Review your post and page URLs for routing conflicts, duplicate risks, readability and title alignment under ARN Smart Linkix → URL Health.

  • Background scan: WP-Cron checks the latest 500 posts, pages and other public content in steps of 50, never in one long request.
  • Routing safety: flags paths that touch a reserved WordPress or system route or are already an active redirect source.
  • Duplicate candidates: content URLs very close to another path family.
  • Readability and alignment: scores slug length, path depth and repeated terms and checks how closely the URL matches the title; commercial product URLs may stay descriptive.
  • Filters: content type, risk (Low, Medium, High), readability and issue (hard conflict, duplicate candidate, long but valid, weak alignment).
  • Smart URL Advisor in the editor: a suggested path, readability score and title alignment for the post you are editing.

⚙️ Dashboard and settings

  • Dashboard: totals for short links, redirects and QR Studio items, QR and routing status, the latest short links, recent redirects and quick actions.
  • Module control: switch Short Links, Redirects, URL Health, Analytics, QR Studio and Bio Pages on or off; a module that is off leaves the menu.
  • Settings tabs: General (short link prefix and modules), QR & branding, Analytics, Language and Maintenance (uninstall cleanup).

🤝 WordPress, Multisite and ARN Free AI

  • WordPress Multisite: network activation sets up every site; each site keeps its own links, redirects and analytics (see FAQ).
  • Translations: text domain arnsmart-url-manager; translations load from WordPress.org language packs.
  • ARN Free AI: includes Settings → ARN Free AI, the shared screen where ARN Free plugins that use AI get their provider, your own API key, model and usage limits. URL Manager itself sends no AI requests.

🔒 Privacy, performance and your data

  • No external tracking or cookies; analytics are stored locally in your WordPress database.
  • No stored IP addresses: unique clicks use a salted hash in the raw event log. Requests and referrers are stored without query strings (the referrer only while “Store referrer classification” is on), with the device type instead of the full user agent.
  • No API connections of its own; only the optional “Test connection” and “Load models” buttons of Settings > ARN Free AI contact an AI provider, when clicked (see External services).
  • Light on visitor requests: table checks and QR drawing never run on visitor requests, background jobs run in short WP-Cron steps, and /favicon.ico and /robots.txt skip the redirect lookup.
  • Deactivation keeps all data; it is removed only when “Enable cleanup on uninstall” is on and the plugin is deleted.

⭐ Go further with ARN Smart Linkix Pro

ARN Smart Linkix Pro includes everything in Free and adds:

  • Custom permalinks for posts and pages, canonical policy and query parameter rules.
  • Smart App Links that open the selected app on mobile with a web fallback, ready-made presets and a shortcode.
  • Advanced redirect rules: device routing (mobile, iOS, Android), scheduled redirects with start, end and fallback URL, and link rotation for A/B or affiliate splits.
  • Broken link checks for redirect targets.
  • Branded QR tools: SVG output, a QR Template Editor with drag-and-drop layout and live preview, PNG cards and shareable asset URLs.
  • Several bio pages and branded splash pages with a countdown, a call-to-action button and Facebook Pixel, Google Tag and LinkedIn Insight IDs; Google Fonts with language subsets and device previews.
  • Settings import and export, license management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Your links, redirects, QR settings and analytics stay in place when you switch; URL Manager never requires Linkix Pro or a license.

🔗 More from ARN Smart

Free on WordPress.org, usable alone or together:

  • ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor – Elementor widgets, header & footer builder, SEO and schema.
  • ARN Smart AI-Powered Visitor Intent – visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics and contact actions.
  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer – local WebP and AVIF image optimization.
  • ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit – controlled draft preparation, duplication and find and replace.

Pro editions with more power and priority support: Vendix, Visioix, WebPix, Clonex, Linkix, SiteWatch, Contix and DualFix. Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

ARN Smart URL Manager does not send any site content to an AI provider and does not contact any ARN server. Links, redirects, QR codes and analytics work entirely on your own site.

Bio page fonts. The Bio page font families Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato and Poppins are bundled with the plugin (assets/fonts) and load from your own site; no request goes to Google Fonts or any other font service. The fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; each family’s license and copyright notice is next to its files.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/modeluse , https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for ARN Smart URL Manager, then install and activate it. You can also upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Open the ARN Smart Linkix menu in your WordPress admin and check Settings: the short link prefix (s by default) and the modules you want to use.
  3. Add your first redirect under Redirects, or your first short link under Short Links (or with Create Short Link in the Posts or Pages list).
  4. Download the QR code from the short link card, and set up your link-in-bio page under Bio Pages if you need one.
sections.faq:
Do I need ARN Smart Linkix Pro or a license key?

No. ARN Smart URL Manager is free, works on its own and has no license key; updates come from WordPress.org. ARN Smart Linkix Pro is optional, available on arnsmart.com, and uses the same data, so your links, redirects, QR settings and analytics stay in place when you switch.

Will it slow down my site?

It is built to add as little as possible to visitor requests. Database table checks and QR drawing never run on visitor requests, admin code loads only in the admin, URL Health and QR maintenance run in short background steps, requests for /favicon.ico and /robots.txt skip the redirect lookup, and counters are written with single atomic queries.

Does it work on WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Network activation sets up every site, each site keeps its own links, redirects, QR files and analytics, and a site added to the network later gets its own tables and rules.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Nothing is removed by default. With “Enable cleanup on uninstall” on (Settings, Maintenance tab), the plugin’s own data is removed (generated QR files only if “Also delete generated QR files” is on too); on a network every site follows its own choice, and sites where ARN Smart Linkix (Pro) is active are left untouched. The shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of the cleaned sites are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them. Deactivation never removes data.

Does it send data to external services or AI?

No. Links, redirects, QR codes and analytics work entirely on your own site, and the plugin sends no site content to an AI provider and contacts no ARN server. Only the optional “Test connection” and “Load models” buttons of the shared Settings > ARN Free AI screen contact the AI provider an administrator chose, when clicked; see External services.

Does this plugin modify my existing WordPress URLs?

No. It works independently and does not modify your existing WordPress URLs. Short links, redirects and the bio page use their own addresses, and URL Health only reports; it changes nothing.

Where is analytics data stored?

All analytics data is stored locally in your WordPress database. Raw event logs are kept for the retention period you set (90 days by default) and removed in small batches, while the click totals of each link are kept.

Why does the URL Health scan show “running in the background”?

The scan runs through WP-Cron in short steps. If WP-Cron is disabled on your site (DISABLE_WP_CRON), make sure a server cron job calls wp-cron.php; otherwise the scan waits until WP-Cron runs.

Can I change a short link’s destination without reprinting its QR code?

Yes. The QR code encodes the short link, not the destination, so you can change the target URL at any time and printed codes keep working. Short links send visitors with a 302 redirect, so browsers always ask for the current destination.

Do short links work with the “Plain” permalink structure?

Yes. With “Plain” permalinks, short links and the bio page use query addresses such as ?linkix_slug=abc12, so they open on every web server; with pretty permalinks they use /s/<slug>/ and /bio/<slug>/.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Fixed: network activation writes the short link and Bio rules on every site of a multisite network; deactivation removes them and each site’s cleanup event, and a new network site gets its own rules.
  • Fixed: a real page under the short link or Bio prefix (a child page of a page named “s” or “bio”) opens instead of answering 404.
  • Fixed: short links with non-Latin slugs open; a short link whose destination is its own address answers 404 instead of looping; editing a short link with an empty Slug keeps its address; destinations keep percent-encoded characters.
  • Fixed: redirect source paths with accents or non-Latin letters are stored percent-encoded, so “café” no longer catches the page /cafe/ and “cafe” is no longer refused as a duplicate; rules saved by ARN Smart Linkix keep working after the site returns here; a redirect that cannot be saved says so.
  • Fixed: visitor destinations are checked without a DNS lookup on every visit, and private addresses or other ports accepted by the screens work.
  • Fixed: Bio buttons and social links with percent-encoded addresses (spaces, non-Latin paths, WhatsApp text) redirect; the intro text and description keep their line breaks; labels keep their backslashes; the live preview shows every button; right-to-left sites draw the page right to left.
  • Fixed: the Bio page font families Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato and Poppins load font files bundled with the plugin, on the page and in the live preview; before, the page was drawn in the visitor’s system font. No request goes to a font service.
  • Fixed: QR Studio content keeps its line breaks, backslashes and percent signs.
  • Fixed: URL Health and QR maintenance run with ALTERNATE_WP_CRON, a scan that stopped says so, and a post added or deleted during a scan no longer shifts the others.
  • Fixed: Settings no longer reset the modules, QR size and Bio prefix that ARN Smart Linkix keeps in the same options; changing the short link prefix redraws the QR codes and drops the old prefix’s rule.
  • Fixed: Redirects and Short Links page through and search every record, and the totals count all links.
  • Fixed: analytics retention and report ranges use the site’s time zone; deleting the plugin with “delete data” also removes the data ARN Smart Linkix left in the same tables and options.
  • Security: the plugin’s screens answer 400 to a field sent as a list; only the exact button value runs an action; Delete takes a nonce bound to its row; short link AJAX needs the manage_options capability; notices no longer travel in the address; list values in visitor query strings no longer log PHP warnings.
  • Privacy: the click log and raw analytics store the request and referrer without query strings, the referrer only while “Store referrer classification” is on, and the device type instead of the full user agent.
  • Changed: Settings → Language describes where translations load from.
  • Fixed: after a site returns from ARN Smart Linkix, short link and Bio addresses work without saving the permalinks, rules saved there with a time window, device addresses or rotation go where Linkix sent visitors, a post with a Linkix custom permalink opens at its own address, and a Smart App Link’s bridge short link no longer goes to the post with the same ID; deleting a network site removes its Linkix tables (where the plugin is active only on single sites, at the next table check of another site running it or when the plugin is deleted).
  • Fixed: Shared ARN Free AI 1.0.6: the retry message shows the real number of attempts; the screen updates after “Remove saved key” and “Clear usage history”; a key set in wp-config.php is not sent to a changed endpoint; reasoning models get no temperature setting; deleting a network site removes its usage table.

Earlier versions: changelog.txt
